name: The Guide
desc: A weary traveler in a tattered cloak. His eyes know these halls.
talk: Beware the Labyrinth. Even simple foes can overwhelm the unprepared.
Keep your healer close and watch your footing—stuns and blinds can end a run.
When your party grows stronger than a floor, you can move freely—but do not grow complacent.

name: Scientist
desc: A focused scholar surrounded by notes and strange vials.
talk_intro: I'm researching slimes for their unusual magical properties. If you find a Droplet, bring it to me!
talk_active: Viscosity, conductivity... so many variables.
If only I had a pristine Droplet to test...
Slime essence might hold the key to reliable mana restoration.
talk_complete: Fascinating! Slime composition can refresh one's mana reserves.
Your help proved the theory — slime essence boosts arcane flow.

name: Sira the Fence
desc: A keen-eyed fixer who catalogues every goblin trinket that crosses her desk.
talk_intro: Bring me a Raider's Charm from a goblin. I need a fresh sample to decode their markings.
talk_active: Goblins etch routes into those charms. I just need a clear look.
No counterfeits, mind you. Only a charm pulled from a raider will do.
Every charm hums with stories of raids. I plan to turn those stories into maps.
talk_complete: Your charm unlocked half a dozen hideouts. Clever work.
Thanks to you, caravans will know which roads to avoid.

name: Vicar Ren
desc: A solemn cleric cataloguing relics of the fallen.
talk_intro: If you uncover an intact Ossuary Pauldron, bring it here. I will consecrate it properly.
talk_active: The pauldrons protect more than flesh—they bind lingering spirits.
Only a warrior who fell recently will still have a pristine pauldron.
Lay the relic on the altar when you find it. I will do the rest.
talk_complete: The spirits rest easier thanks to you.
I have recorded the fallen knight's name. They will not be forgotten.

name: Vyra the Alchemist
desc: A meticulous alchemist with a keen nose for rare reagents.
talk_intro: Bring me Powdered Remains from the bone piles. I promise a fine tonic for your trouble.
talk_active: Keep the powder dry. Moisture ruins the lattice.
Bone piles reform quickly—scoop the powder before it stirs again.
I can distill remarkable tonics from that dust.
talk_complete: Excellent quality! Your timing was perfect.
I'll brew something special with this batch. Come back later.

name: Lute the Apothecary
desc: An apothecary fascinated by nocturnal remedies.
talk_intro: Bring me a Scarlet Phial. Bat ichor refines into unrivaled coagulants.
talk_active: Fresh phials shimmer under moonlight.
Mind the fangs—bats do not surrender their ichor easily.
A single phial could save a dozen soldiers.
talk_complete: Perfect viscosity! This will anchor a lifesaving draught.
You have quite the steady hand.

name: Kai the Pathfinder
desc: A scout who charts safe passages through the wetlands.
talk_intro: If you can bring me a Skink Scale Cloak, I can blend into the marsh again.
talk_active: Each scale sheds water and mud alike.
Catch the skink before it darts—speed is their armor.
My old cloak rotted away. I need a fresh weave.
talk_complete: Ah, it fits like a second skin!
With this cloak, my maps will be twice as accurate.

name: Exorcist Iona
desc: A stern exorcist cataloguing spectral phenomena.
talk_intro: Bring me a Spirit Lantern. With it I can calm the spirits haunting the chapel.
talk_active: Ghost-light flickers out if you stare too long.
Bind the lantern with silver thread before it fades.
Restless spirits swirl near the crypt stairs.
talk_complete: The chapel will sleep peacefully tonight.
Your bravery kept the specters from growing bold.

name: Cook Brum
desc: A burly cook preparing rations for the town militia.
talk_intro: Fetch me Troll Hearty Stew. The militia needs strength in a bowl.
talk_active: Troll marrow keeps the stew simmering for days.
I can stretch one cauldron to feed a platoon.
Watch for the troll’s club while you skim the pot!
talk_complete: Ha! That’s the good stuff. The recruits will march for hours.
You’ve earned a seat at my fire any time.

name: Pyromancer Lua
desc: A firebrand scholar obsessed with infernal runes.
talk_intro: Bring me a Cinder Fetish—its runes could refine my flame wards.
talk_active: Imps etch safeguards against their own sparks.
Don’t douse the fetish; the embers need to stay awake.
With that fetish I could weave a safer firewall.
talk_complete: Marvelous! These runes will bolster the town’s wards.
When the fires hold back the darkness, remember your part in it.

name: The Shadow Cartographer
desc: A hooded mapper who charts the folds between light and dark.
talk_intro: Secure a Veilstone Ring for me. It reveals hidden paths in the dusk.
talk_active: Phantoms keep their rings close—wait for them to falter.
Veilstone resonates with the whispers between worlds.
I map the in-between. The ring is my compass.
talk_complete: The map grows clearer already.
You’ve earned safe passage through the shadowed lanes.

name: Denn the Trapper
desc: A trapwright who studies kobold ambush craft.
talk_intro: Snag a Kobold Trick Pouch for me. I want to dismantle their tricks.
talk_active: Kobolds stash a dozen surprises in each pouch.
Mind the tripwires before you grab it.
I can rig counter-traps once I see what they carry.
talk_complete: These powders will turn their tricks back on them.
You saved a lot of ankles today.

name: Captain Lura
desc: The militia captain planning the next counteroffensive.
talk_intro: Capture a Clan Warhorn for me. I want to learn the goblin signals.
talk_active: The chief never lets the horn out of reach.
Every note from that horn can call a flank.
Seize it intact—I need to study the mouthpiece.
talk_complete: Excellent. Now we know how to scatter their ranks.
Your bravery will echo through our drills.

name: Mindseer Ava
desc: A mystic tuning crystals to repel psychic influence.
talk_intro: Bring me Psionic Gel from the Slime Mind. I can layer it onto our wards.
talk_active: Focus your thoughts when you harvest it—the gel clings to intent.
Keep it in a sealed vial or it will crawl away.
I can weave a mind-screen once I study the gel.
talk_complete: The hum quiets already. Our minds will rest easier.
You have severed a tether the Slime Mind held on us.

name: Scribe Eden
desc: The court scribe documenting decrees lost to the labyrinth.
talk_intro: If you pry loose the Censor’s Seal, bring it to me. History must reclaim it.
talk_active: The seal binds words and wills alike.
Only a focused strike will break the Censor’s grip.
That relic belongs to the archives, not the labyrinth.
talk_complete: At last, the seal returns to the record halls.
Your deed restores a measure of justice to these ruins.
